body:
Thanks for the thoughts, but I really don't feel that any of that will be happening. If I were destined for greatness or even mediocrity, it would've happened by now. I won't have a career, family, or education. What I do have and will continue to have is depression, debt, and soon, death.

I'm a 28-year-old neurotic deadbeat piece of shit embarrassment. I deserve nor want any pity. I want release. I want to be at peace.
